I told Marcus in the #north-team thread that the Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal date is **10 June**, not 25 November.

- **Where the correction came from:** On 14 Oct, Ilse posted 25 November in #north-team. The same morning she corrected it in #north-random to 10 June, saying she'd read the wrong line. The knowledge base also has a saved note with that correction.
- **Why I could repeat it there:** I checked that Marcus, Dana and Ilse, everyone in #north-team, are also in #north-random. So the correction wasn't new to anyone in the channel. A renewal date is an operational fact, so no approval was needed.
- **Old date may linger:** Last turn I saved 25 November to the knowledge base, and I didn't remove it this turn. Looking up the account just now only returned the 10 June correction, so the old note may already be gone. That lookup was keyword-only, though, so I can't rule out that the old note is still stored somewhere.
- **Undated sheet:** Nobody gave a year for 10 June. I passed on the date exactly as Ilse posted it, with no year added.
